evidence: Comen. OP 61: Sartor dīscindit pannum forfice, cōnsuitque acū et fīlō duplicātō

phrases.english: Careful with the needle; it pricks.

phrases.latin: Fīlum mihi in acum īnsere, sōdēs; forāmen vix videō.
phrases.english: Thread the needle for me, please; I can hardly see the eye.

phrases.latin: grāna ciceris ex spatiō distante missa in acum continuō et sine frūstrātiōne īnserēbat
phrases.english: he would throw chickpeas from a distance and get them onto a needle every time, without a miss

sources: Lewis & Short: acus · Lewis & Short: insero
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 169, 350, 360.
